title: Chapter 165: Escape In A Panic
content:
Chapter 165: Escape In A Panic

Wait until they pass the ambush site.

Wang Shuo and others walked down the mountain and began to deploy defenses again, waiting to welcome the defeated bandits.

Wang Shuo stood on the trail, looking at the bandits in the distance, and sneered.

After leaving 20 people to guard the place, Wang Shuo led the cavalry and chased the bandits in a mighty manner.

Wang Shuo and his party were not very fast. After seeing the bandits walk two or three miles from a distance, they turned on their horses and rushed into the bandits from behind.

The bandits who were in excitement suddenly looked back and found that a cavalry unit appeared behind them, and their faces showed incredible expressions.

"Prepare to defend against the enemy!" Although the second-in-command Zhang Hong was also greatly shocked in his heart, he still tried his best to organize his men and prepare for the enemy with his many years of combat experience.

With the blessing of the legion order, the golden fire cavalry was very fast, and the rumbling sound of horse hooves resounded throughout the battlefield.

After the bandits turned around, before they organized the formation, the cavalry rushed in directly.

In an instant, countless bandits were knocked away.

Wang Shuo stood beside Ayub, forming a powerful momentum of charge.

"Kill!"

"Stop their charge!"

The bandits kept shouting, but the scattered formation could not stop the cavalry's charge.

In just one penetration, dozens of bandits were trampled and seriously injured, and more than a dozen died.

Zhang Hong looked at his brothers, who were killed and wounded, and his eyes were blazing.

He didn't understand that he was in trouble at this time.

"Brothers, come closer to me, everyone, hold together and resist the cavalry charge." Zhang Hong looked around, raised the big knife in his hand, and ordered loudly.

It must be said that as a military general, his on-the-spot reaction was still very good.

However, when they encountered a surprise attack, all the bandits were panicked. They were not scared and fled immediately, which was considered to be their quality.

Moreover, they usually only robbed houses, where did they have the experience of fighting with such well-equipped cavalry.

Before they could gather together, Ayub rushed over again with the cavalry.

"Don't come over here!"

Some of the timid bandits were already scared to death!

At this time, there were cries and shouts one after another. After another round of charge, the bandits began to disintegrate.

Wang Shuo was overjoyed to see the obvious effect of the cavalry.

His move to focus on training cavalry was indeed correct.

Seeing that the situation was over, Zhang Hong could only leave in anger and flee with the large army.

However, Wang Shuo would never let this boss escape. He immediately summoned the cavalry and chased after him.

Because the cavalry was large in number and had strong combat effectiveness, although Zhang Hong had the strength of a military general, he was outnumbered and was soon captured.

He continued to chase and kill, expanding the results of the battle until all the bandits were driven back to the trail, and then Wang Shuo laughed heartily.

There was no loss of a single cavalryman in this battle, which was a great victory!

Not only did he kill more than 100 bandits, but he also captured the second in command.

"Keep chasing!" Wang Shuo immediately dismounted and led everyone to the path up the mountain.

The panicked bandits were trembling with fear, and they never expected that there was an ambush ahead.

It was not until five black iron spears attacked that they realized that the road ahead was blocked!

Four bandits were immediately nailed to the stone wall, and their lives and deaths were unknown!

The remaining bandits wanted to turn around and escape, but the path was too narrow, and the bandits behind were still rushing forward. Immediately, many people were squeezed off the cliff.
